notes.title: 911 Operator Final Update
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

911 Operator has been released over 4 years ago. A lot of you are still playing the game, and some of you discover it for the very first time. That's why we have decided to come back to you with this one last final update! We realize that some of you have problems with map download, especially in certain areas around the world. That's why we have decided to add over 20 new maps to the base game: 

[list]
[*] Buenos Aires
[*] Madrid
[*] Kanton
[*] Jakarta
[*] Kyiv
[*] Amsterdam
[*] Toronto
[*] Ankara
[*] Saint Petersburg
[*] Santiago
[*] Bogota
[*] Vienna
[*] Singapore
[*] Chengdu
[*] Nanjing
[*] Sydney
[*] Shinjuku
[*] Rio de Janeiro
[*] Melbourne
[*] Brussels
[*] Manila
[*] Stockholm
[/list]
Other than that we have changed some of the spelling errors and other minor bugs, that were kept unattended over the years. With those final changes, we consider 911 Operator a complete game. Maybe it's time to play once again through the main campaign? 

[h2]Something Ends, Something Begins[/h2]
Although we now consider our work on 911 Operator to be over, the team that has brought you 911 Operator and 112 Operator is working hard on a brand new game! It might be a bit of a surprise, as it isn't an emergency simulator this time, but a post-apocalyptic city-builder strategy game. What stays the same then? We are still committed to creating the best games played on real-world maps. That's why your job in this new title will be to build a settlement and protect it from deadly hordes of infected. It's your choice where you want to play and how you want to achieve your victory. 

By-the-way, this game was introduced by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570180/112_Operator__The_Last_Duty/]THE LAST DUTY DLC[/url] to 112 Operator. Check how the story starts, and what happened to our Operator!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/infection-free-zone-city-survival-with-real-maps?ref=81vu4y]CLICK HERE[/url] to support the Kickstarter campaign for [b]Infection Free Zone[/b]. We will be extremely happy to have you on board! It's our main goal to keep the community happy with the new direction we are taking, so your feedback is going to be well appreciated. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465460/Infection_Free_Zone/

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

notes.title: 911, emergency!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=EtSlFpqb1jM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Hey, Operators![/h1]

Please respond immediately! We need assistance with an urgent case - the announcement of 911 Operator Interactive Movie!

In 911 Operator Interactive Movie, created on the 911 Operator license, it’s the player’s decisions that shape the story. One emergency call starts a race against time and your every action can save or cost many lives. Interaction will go beyond choosing dialogue lines - the movie will feature gameplay elements known from 911 Operator!

This full-feature movie, which blurs the lines between “players” and “viewers” is being produced by Iron Wolf Studio, with the support of Games Operators.

[h2]Key features of 911 Operator Interactive Movie:[/h2] 

:thisisaphone: Exciting, interactive thriller with Philip Lenkovsky (“Amadeus”, “Stardust Memories”)
:thisisaphone: Choices which matter and lead to one of multiple endings
:thisisaphone: Gameplay elements from 911 Operator integrated in the movie

ADD TO YOUR STEAM WISHLIST NOW!:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1506470/

notes.title: Cyber Ops - RELEASED
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Operators! [/h1]

[h2]We are more than happy to announce that [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/863460/Cyber_Ops/]Cyber Ops is out now[/url].[/b] [/h2] 
Now with loyalty discount for owners of 911 Operator!

For the last two years, we have been making this game with hard work and a big passion. Cyber Ops offers an immersive world with memorable characters and a fresh challenge for you to enjoy. All of this was made especially for you, so you can join the Geist Division and live this new experience.

[previewyoutube=XBHGnY8ZDXQ;full]<video>[/previewyoutube]

Become a part of the Geist Division, a secret high-tech unit created by the government to protect the country from all kinds of next-gen threats. You are the eye in the sky, the invisible hand, the cyber ghost, looking after your team over the net.

Features
[list]
[*]More than 6 hours of story missions full of cyberpunk themes, investigation and political intrigue.
[*]Real-time audio feedback from squad leaders brings life to the world of Cyber Ops.
[*]Different hacking mechanics to keep control of doors, security devices and cyberlink-equipped brains.
[*]Squad management: recruit new blood for the infiltration squads.
[*]Research and Development: develop new cyber-implants to improve the agents performance.
[*]Retro-futuristic computer interfaces and dark analog synth-based music inspired by 80's cult movies.
[/list]



Hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34265206/5eb44414b272b9e4106e3f178e7ab5f087dc1591.png[/img]

notes.title: Game update, new DLC + GIVEAWAY!
notes.content:
[h1]Our new DLC is just around the corner! [/h1]
It includes fresh calls, new Career cities, events and a whole new mechanic - search for missing children, stolen cars and many, many more! Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/606971/911_Operator__Search__Rescue/] 911 Operator - Search & Rescue[/url], going live on [b]July 26th[/b]!

[h1]Facebook Giveaway[/h1]
To celebrate the DLC’s launch, we’re throwing a [b]giveaway[/b] on our  [url=https://www.facebook.com/GamesOperators/] Facebook page[/url]. Make sure to like it and stay tuned to win Search and Rescue codes!

[h1]Base game update[/h1]
We've also updated the base game, fixing some bugs and adding features like sliders for dialogue options, new tips, saving units' positions after deployment and more!

notes.title: New DLC "EVERY LIFE MATTERS" available now!
notes.content:
Handle riots in Boston, secure music festival in Miami, try new Reinforcements function and experience special events in the Free Game mode.

"Every Life Matters" is a new expansion to 911 Operator, which add plenty of new content to the game:

- New REINFORCEMENTS function which lets you summon additional units during your duty
- Four special EVENTS during the Free Game mode (including a festival, a riot and an earthquake)
- Two new cities for the career mode: Miami and Boston
- 12 new conversations
- 18 new reports
- Two new pieces of equipment: pepper spray and riot gear
- Two new vehicles: the prison van and the water cannon

That's the biggest DLC, we've ever made for 911 Operator and we hope you will like it. Check it now by clicking here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/580731/911_Operator__Every_Life_Matters/
